scope: Add dev-branch push triggering to the single canonical oya-ci-required workflow so post-merge/dev updates run the same required CI product automatically.

hyperscaler_lens.north_star: CI is the product: one canonical cloud-native required status check must run on PRs, merge groups, manual dispatch, and protected dev updates.
principles: post-merge protected-branch verification is automatic, not human-triggered
GitHub Actions is bridge runner only; oya-ci-required remains the product contract
small workflow trigger changes still carry machine-readable evidence and generated-face fixpoint proof

root_cause.problem: Canonical oya-ci-required ran on PRs and manual dispatch but did not run after dev branch updates, leaving a post-merge verification gap.
root_cause.fix: Add push.branches: [dev] while preserving workflow_dispatch, pull_request.branches: [dev], and merge_group triggers.

verification.evidence: workflow_dispatch, push[dev], pull_request[dev], and merge_group triggers are present.
No Markdown files in branch diff.

verification.command: buck2 git-facts emitter + accounting-registry producer, then registry-drift
verification.evidence: Run after evidence commit and generated-face settle; final PR branch must pass registry-drift locally and remotely.

verification.command: git diff $(git merge-base HEAD origin/dev)..HEAD -- . ':(exclude)Cargo.lock' | grep -E -i 'password\s*=|api[_-]?key\s*=|secret\s*=|private[_-]?key|token\s*='
verification.evidence: No obvious secret assignments expected; final scan runs after settle.

known_gaps: Remote oya-ci-required must rerun on PR #620 after force-with-lease push.
Reviewer approval is still required before merge.

rollback.reversibility: Revert the workflow trigger commit and generated-face settle; no runtime/data migration.
rollback.merge_policy: Do not merge without remote oya-ci-required green and reviewer approval.

closure: Evidence added; generated faces must be settled and verified before PR #620 is considered ready.
